by
  intro R ι _ _ I h
  have h' : Pairwise (fun i j => IsCoprime (I i) (I j)) := fun i j hij => Ideal.isCoprime_iff_sup_eq.mpr (h i j hij)
  exact ⟨Ideal.quotientInfRingEquivPiQuotient I h', fun x i => rfl⟩
target_source: ∀ (R ι : Type*) [CommRing R] [Fintype ι] (I : ι → Ideal R), (∀ i j, i ≠ j → I i ⊔ I j = ⊤) → ∃ e : (R ⧸ ⨅ i, I i) ≃+* ∀ i, R ⧸ I i, ∀ (x : R) (i : ι), e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x) i = Ideal.Quotient.mk (I i) x
